meaning:
συ-στέφω
[in LXX chiefly for קָשַׁר ;]
1. to twist together: with accusative of thing(s), Act.28:3.
2. Pass., of persons, to gather themselves together: Mat.17:22 (WH, R, mg.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,
But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat, and fastened on his hand.
